title: Cubic border-determinantal lower bound for the permanent
exact_target: Does the border-determinantal complexity of the m×m complex permanent grow at least c $m^{3}$ for one absolute $c>0$ and all sufficiently large m? Border complexity permits coefficient limits of affine-linear determinant representations.
